TIVASA — Industrial HVAC and VRF Website

TIVASA

A digital presence for an industrial HVAC company.

TIVASA is a custom-designed website built to showcase an industrial HVAC company's products, projects, and technical expertise through a clear, modern digital experience.

The project combines an editorial visual identity with structured product presentations, project showcases, and carefully crafted interactions, balancing industrial character with a refined, professional aesthetic.

From design and development to deployment, the goal was to create a distinctive digital platform that communicates TIVASA's expertise and presents its work with clarity and confidence.
